brief:
Palestinian journalist and activist Abed Abu Shehadeh was freed from Israeli police custody on Tuesday, according to Middle East Eye, after spending five days in detention. The circumstances of his arrest and the reasons for his release were not disclosed in initial reports.

Abu Shehadeh, known for his work as both a journalist and activist, had been held by Israeli police since his detention earlier in the week.
dek: Palestinian journalist and activist freed from Israeli police custody after five-day detention The Palestinian journalist and activist Abed Abu Shehadeh has been freed following five days in Israeli police custody.
title: Israeli police release Palestinian journalist after five-day detention
